items: Social media is an inexpensive way for restaurants, including small ones, to build trust, engage guests and gather insight from what people say about them.
Optimize your bio on every platform first, with your contact details, location, a short description and a map link, so interested people can find and reach you.
Mix content types such as recipes, behind-the-scenes stories, events, staff features and reshared guest posts, then focus on what gets the most engagement.
Reply to negative comments and reviews as well as positive ones, because an open conversation shows guests you value their feedback and reveals where service needs work.
Keep a consistent tone across channels, let people order through your bio link or messages, and partner with local food influencers to reach new audiences.
